result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The last restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it unclear what the full restaurant name is.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') or ensure the card width accommodates the text within its bounds.
